name: PS5 GBAX
description: Native Game Boy Advance emulator for PS5 using mGBA 0.10.5 with the PS5SX2 cover-flow interface. Supports GBA ROMs and ZIP archives from internal storage, USB and NFSv3 shares, automatic box-art downloads, save states, battery saves, fast forward, configurable controls and 4K graphics modes.
author: YAHBALLON
